question: I'm reading https://dealectric.com/solar-watts-to-recharge-power-station — What's the cheapest 400 W portable panel here, and which stations will it work with?

The cheapest 400 W portable panel listed is the **ALLPOWERS SP037**: **$299**, or **$269.10 with code `ALLPOWERS26`**. It has a 45.3 V open-circuit voltage. [Panel details and offer](https://dealectric.com/allpowers-sp037-400w-solar-panel) · [Buy](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-sp037-400w-solar-panel)

According to the [comparison article](https://dealectric.com/solar-watts-to-recharge-power-station), it works with these eight listed stations:

- ALLPOWERS R600, P1800, S2000 Pro and R4000
- BLUETTI AC180, AC200L, Elite 200 V2 and Elite 300
